answer: Each identity keeps half of a split ivory tally, serial unique. Its match is sealed in a basalt archive. Each epoch its half is shown at the lotus-pond registry; an auditor fits the halves. Each fake needs a new ivory tally (45) and basalt filing (12). 1,000 fakes cost 57,000 plus 70,000 locked, against at most 40,000 in rewards. A lent tally fails its lender at the lotus registry: one half cannot serve two holders. An honest agent pays 57 once.
